facts.fact: The Paradigm Initiative report describes Namibia's policy framework as including the 'newly launched' National Digital Strategy (2025); the source's verb is launched and it names no adopting act or body.

The report's Table 1 lists the Ministry of Information and Communication Technology (MICT) as lead institution for Namibia's National Broadband Policy and National Digital Strategy, which it dates 'ongoing'; the table date is the report's own (2026-09-22).
